limitations: Machine hits are broad leads, not evidence of implemented safeguards.
Primary A>B>C>D precedence is accounting only; all overlapping memberships retained.
All obligation sums use exact-key, transaction-deduplicated financial_actions rows, preserving negative amounts. Ceilings and SBIR headline values are never added.
Missing amounts and missing end dates remain null/explicitly missing, not zero or assumed inactive.
FY windows use source fiscal_year. CY window uses action_date through 2026-10-25. Snapshot coverage does not extend automatically to cutoff.
Performer-recipient matching is not proof of ASIMOV continuation; PSC/NAICS and scope review remain necessary.
Input source universe is bounded; screening does not establish worldwide or classified-program absence.
financial_action_corpus_scope_limitation: Money is net obligations within the acquired action corpus/window, not complete award funding. Acquisition filters can omit older positive, negative or zero actions; these nets are not guaranteed lower bounds. Internal joins, hashes and conservation do not prove source-history completeness. Keep live complete-history sums separate.
